claims.claim: The Israeli standard corporate tax rate is 23% in 2026, the same as 2025
claims.raw_snippet: The corporate tax rate is 23% in 2026 (same rate as in 2025).

claims.claim: A Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax imposes a 15% minimum effective tax rate on large multinational groups, applying for tax years beginning after 31 December 2025
claims.raw_snippet: Such MNE groups will be required to pay a top-up tax where their Israeli operations have an effective tax rate of less than 15%. The QDMTT shall apply for tax years beginning after 31 December 2025.

claims.claim: For a closely held company, income is reclassified to the individual where 70% or more of total or taxable income comes from services performed for a single entity, and separately, as of 2025, profitability exceeding 25% pushes the active shareholder's pro-rata share of the excess into their taxable income at their marginal rate
claims.raw_snippet: The income reclassification shall apply if 70% or more of the total income or taxable income of the closely held company in the tax year is sourced from the services performed by the individual or the individual's relatives for a single entity during a period of at least 22 months during a three-year period.

claims.claim: An annual 2% tax applies to accumulated undistributed profits of a closely held company, effective 2025
claims.raw_snippet: Tax on accumulated profits As of 2025, closely held companies ( as defined above ) are generally required to pay an annual tax of 2% on certain accumulated profits.

claims.claim: The Preferred Enterprise corporate tax rate is 7.5% in development area A and 16% outside development area A
claims.raw_snippet: The PFE corporate tax rate is 7.5% for operations in ‘development area A’ and 16% for operations outside development area A.

claims.claim: Dividends from Preferred Enterprise profits carry a 20% withholding tax rate, reducible under treaties
claims.raw_snippet: The WHT rate applicable to dividends from PFE profits is 20%, which may be reduced under certain tax treaties.

claims.claim: The Special Preferred Enterprise corporate tax rate is 5% in development area A and 8% outside development area A, for ten years
claims.raw_snippet: The SPFE corporate tax rate is 5% for operations in development area A and 8% for operations outside of development area A for ten years. After ten years, the PFE tax rates shall apply unless the company has a new investment program that requalifies the company again for SPFE status.

claims.claim: Special Preferred Enterprise status requires annual revenue of at least ILS 1 billion and membership in a group generating at least ILS 10 billion annually in the same industrial sector
claims.raw_snippet: To qualify, an Israeli company must meet certain conditions, such as having SPFE annual revenue greater than or equal to ILS 1 billion and being part of a group of companies that generates annual revenues greater than or equal to ILS 10 billion in the same industrial sector in which the Israeli company operates.

claims.claim: Under the Preferred Technology Enterprise regime, reduced corporate tax rates of 7.5% in development area A or 12% outside development area A apply to qualifying income, limited to the portion of IP developed in Israel on a nexus approach
claims.raw_snippet: Under the PTE regime, reduced corporate tax rates of 7.5% for operations in development area A or 12% for operations outside of development area A shall apply on qualifying income, subject to detailed rules. These corporate tax rates shall apply only with respect to the portion of intellectual property (IP) developed in Israel, based on a nexus approach.

claims.claim: Preferred Technology Enterprise eligibility requires group aggregate annual revenues below ILS 10 billion and average R&D expenses over the prior three years of at least 7% of total revenues or exceeding ILS 75 million per year
claims.raw_snippet: To be eligible for the PTE regime, a company must engage in the technology sector and be part of a group of companies with aggregate annual revenues less than ILS 10 billion and meet one of the following two tests: The enterprise's average R&D expenses in the three years prior to the current tax year must be greater than or equal to 7% of the company's total revenues or exceed ILS 75 million per year.

claims.claim: A reduced 4% withholding tax may apply to Preferred Technology Enterprise dividends paid to a foreign company where at least 90% of the payer's shares are held by foreign resident companies, otherwise 20%
claims.raw_snippet: A reduced 4% WHT rate may apply to dividends paid to a foreign company, provided that at least 90% of the payer's shares are held by foreign resident companies. For other dividend distributions, the WHT rate shall be 20%, which may be reduced under certain tax treaties.

claims.claim: Under the Special Preferred Technology Enterprise regime a reduced corporate tax rate of 6% applies to qualifying income, and eligibility requires group aggregate annual revenues of at least ILS 10 billion
claims.raw_snippet: To be eligible for the SPTE regime, a company must meet the eligibility conditions of a PTE above and be part of a group of companies with aggregate annual revenues of at least ILS 10 billion.

claims.claim: Companies selling IP to a related foreign company may qualify for a reduced 12% capital gains tax rate where the IP was acquired from a foreign company after 1 January 2017 for at least ILS 200 million, subject to Israel Innovation Authority approval
claims.raw_snippet: Companies that sell IP to a related foreign company may qualify for a reduced 12% capital gains tax rate, provided that the company acquired the IP from a foreign company after 1 January 2017 for at least ILS 200 million, subject to the approval of the Israeli Innovation Authority.

claims.claim: סעיף 104 לפקודת מס הכנסה. claims.claim: Israeli tax law permits non-taxable reorganizations where ownership and business continuity are maintained, deferring the tax liability until the transferred shares or assets are actually sold
claims.raw_snippet: Israeli tax law allows for non-taxable reorganisations in situations in which the ownership and business enterprise of the original parties is continued after the reorganisation takes place, allowing for the deferral of the tax liability until the shares or assets transferred in such reorganisations are actually sold.

claims.raw_snippet: הלשכה המרכזית לסטטיסטיקה

claims.raw_snippet: The tax on undistributed profits may be avoided if the company distributes a dividend equal to: (i) at least 6%

claims.raw_snippet: These betas might provide better estimates of costs of equity for undiversified owners of private businesses.

claims.raw_snippet: Lack of a valuation basis for the asset or the shares

claims.raw_snippet: The real gain, if any, realised upon the sale of shares purchased on or after 1 January 2003 is generally taxed at a rate of 25% for individuals.

claims.claim: A 3% surtax applies to annual taxable income from all sources above ILS 721,560 in 2026, and as of 2025 an additional 2% surtax applies to the portion of income from capital sources, including capital gains, above that threshold (בעברית: הסף הוא 721,560 שקל בשנת 2026)
claims.raw_snippet: exceeding a certain threshold (ILS 721,560 in 2026) is subject to an additional surtax of 2%

claims.raw_snippet: The ordinary individual tax rate (determined in accordance with the individual’s marginal tax rate in the range of 31% to 50%) will be applied to the gain amount

claims.raw_snippet: The AE and BE regimes discussed below were tax incentive programs granted to operations qualifying under the Law prior to the Law's amendments in 2005 and 2011.

claims.claim: Dividends from AE/BE profits earned in the benefits period carry 15% withholding if distributed during the benefits period or the following 12 years, reducible under treaty
claims.raw_snippet: A WHT rate of 15% (subject to a possible reduction under a tax treaty) applies to dividends paid from profits of an AE/BE earned during the benefits period if distributed either during the benefits period or during the subsequent 12 years.

claims.claim: Damodaran's country risk data updates more than twice a year: the data-current index lists an April 1, 2026 update between the January and July 2026 files
claims.raw_snippet: April 1, 2026 update

claims.claim: Companies Law s.303: a court may approve a distribution that fails the profit test if the solvency test is met
claims.raw_snippet: בית המשפט רשאי, לבקשת חברה, לאשר לה לבצע חלוקה שלא מקיימת את מבחן הרווח, ובלבד ששוכנע שמתקיים מבחן יכולת הפירעון

claims.claim: Section 85א (סעיף 85א): an international transaction between parties with a special relationship is reported and taxed at market conditions
claims.raw_snippet: תדווח העסקה בהתאם לתנאי השוק ותחויב במס בהתאם

claims.claim: Transfer pricing is governed by the Income Tax (Determination of Market Conditions) Regulations, 2006
claims.raw_snippet: תקנות מס הכנסה (קביעת תנאי שוק), התשס״ז–2006

claims.claim: Section 62א(א1)(2)(ג): paragraph (1) does not apply where, among other conditions, the company's accumulated profits at the end of the previous year did not exceed ILS 750,000 (750 אלף שקלים חדשים)
claims.raw_snippet: לא עלה על 750 אלף שקלים חדשים

claims.claim: Section 62א(א1)(2)(ג)(1): the small-company exclusion also requires that no controlling shareholder is a controlling shareholder in another company
claims.raw_snippet: אין בין בעלי השליטה בה יחיד שהוא בעל שליטה בחברה אחרת

claims.claim: Section 62א(א1)(2)(ב): where the company's share in a partnership's income is under 10%, paragraph (1) does not apply to it and subsection (א2) applies
claims.raw_snippet: היה פחות מ־10% – לא יחולו הוראות פסקה (1), ויחולו הוראות סעיף קטן (א2)

claims.claim: ע"א 9308/20 (בית חוסן): by majority, in a private company that is a quasi-partnership a buyback is a dividend in kind to the remaining shareholders pro rata plus a capital-gains purchase by them, which the court said is consistent with the first alternative of Income Tax Circular 2/2018
claims.raw_snippet: נפסק ברוב דעות (השופטת רונן והשופט פוגלמן) כי בחברות שהן מעין שותפויות ברכישה עצמית יש שתי עסקאות דיבידנד בעין של בעלי המניות הנותרים לפי חלקם היחסי ערב המכירה ועסקת רווח הון כשבעלי מניות נותרים רוכשים את חלק המוכרים זאת בהתאם לחלופה הראשונה בחוזר מס הכנסה 2/2018

claims.claim: Companies Law s.1: "purchase" for the definition of distribution includes the company giving financing for the purchase of its own shares
claims.raw_snippet: ”רכישה“ – רכישה או מתן מימון לרכישה, במישרין או בעקיפין, בידי חברה

claims.claim: ע"א 9308/20 (בית חוסן): remaining shareholders are taxed on a dividend equal to their pre-transaction holding percentage multiplied by the amount paid for the departing shareholder's shares
claims.raw_snippet: לחייב את בעלי המניות הנותרים במס דיבידנד בשווי המכפלה של שיעור אחזקותיהם בחברה ערב העסקה בסכום שבו נרכשו מניותיו של בעל המניות היוצא

claims.claim: Section 62א(א1)(2)(ג)(1): a dormant company with no accumulated profits does not count as another company for the small-company exclusion
claims.raw_snippet: לא תיחשב כחברה אחרת, ובלבד שאין לה רווחים נצברים

claims.claim: ע"א 9308/20, Ronen J. (majority): the dividend taxed is the company funds used for the buyback multiplied by the remaining shareholders' holding percentage just before the transaction; the result is consistent with the first alternative in Circular 2/2018
claims.raw_snippet: בשיעור אחזקותיהם של בעלי המניות הנותרים ערב העסקה
